description: Runs the workspace's verification gates (tests, lint, type checks) through the command policy and saves verification.json. Only commands the developer already approved run: the workspace must be trusted (devflow trust) and each command approved "always" or with --allow in a terminal. Commands not yet approved are returned as denials with their fingerprints, never approved by this tool. Runs `devflow verify --json`.

backend.description: Where gate commands run: local, or container (Docker, no network).

baseline.description: Compare with the verification.json of an earlier run.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_verify
title: Run the verification gates
